title: Publication contract example
learningObjectives: Recognise that technical validation cannot replace required human approval.
prompt: Which statement matches the governed publication contract?

options.text: A passing schema check grants clinical approval.
options.explanation: Schema validation checks structure only and cannot grant clinical approval.

options.text: Required human approvals remain separate from technical validation.
options.explanation: Clinical, evidence, source-clearance, and publication decisions remain human-controlled.

options.text: Private draft questions may enter Search before review.
options.explanation: Draft questions remain excluded from public routes, Search, sitemap, and static output.
